name: flowsavvy-linear
description: Sync assigned Linear issues to FlowSavvy on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run

FLOW_SAVVY_EMAIL.description: Email address used to sign in to FlowSavvy

FLOW_SAVVY_PASSWORD.description: Password used to sign in to FlowSavvy

LINEAR_WEBHOOKS.description: JSON array containing each Linear signing secret and its FlowSavvy profile mapping

MINUTES_PER_POINT.description: FlowSavvy task duration assigned to each Linear estimate point (default 15)
